note_en: 才 shows that something happened later or took more effort than you'd expect: 花了差不多两个小时，才把它从头设置好 "it took nearly two hours before I had it all set up." At the end Grandma says 然后我才给你打的 "and only then did I call you" — she hung up first. 就 is the opposite: it stresses that something happened quickly and right away.
